title: Numerical investigation of vanadium distill-condensation via computational fluid dynamics
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18257-18269
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01311B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zeli Yang, Yong Fan, Yimin Zhang, Qiushi Zheng, Peng Liu, Jiang Huang
A coupled VOF-Species-DPM-UDF numerical framework is developed to investigate the distillation-condensation behavior of VOCl3; vapor under nitrogen protection, revealing gas–liquid interface evolution and impurity particle migration mechanisms.
